newsitem.title: USA: Universal Electronics ends unit sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Universal Electronics ends unit sale talks.

text.p: Universal Electronics Inc said on Friday that its negotiations with a previously undisclosed third party which had made an offer for the company's One For All branded United States retail business have ended.

"Without giving us the details, the president of the potential acquiring company stated that they were unable to continue the discussions due to an inability to obtain their board's final approval," the company said in a press release.
The company said that this news will not adversely affect the way in which it had planned to operate its business during 1997.
It said that it will continue to look at acceptable divestiture plans, acquisition targets, and strategic partners.
